messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: hosted-backlog growth detected. queue_size > 250k in us-east1 model-pool-gpu. p95 latency spike to 1.2s, p99 7.8s. error_rate 4.6% across requests
emma-sre: Seeing it too. Paging @kai-oncall. This looks like a GPU node exhaustion event — autoscaler not creating new nodes
kai-oncall: I'm on it. Jumping into metrics + provisioner logs
infra-eng: Confirmed: pool 'model-pool-gpu' at 100% GPU utilization. Autoscaler returned 403 from cloud API: capacity quota exceeded. Provisioner loops with 'rate limit' messages
nora-ml: Which model fleet is hot? Any single tenant causing the spike?
infra-eng: It's spread across multiple models but dominated by 'gptx-13b-quant' and a few heavy batched requests from partner A
jordan-support: Partner A reported higher traffic; they're in contact. We should assess customer visible errors now
emma-sre: Root message: queue growth -> timeouts. Need immediate mitigation to reduce p99 and customer timeouts. Options: emergency rate limit, fallback to smaller quantized models, route some traffic to dedicated pools if available
kai-oncall: Executing emergency steps. First: apply soft global backpressure at edge for user-tier=free to protect paid customers
kai-oncall: /run edgectl rate-limit --selector 'user_tier=free' --rate 10rps
deploy-bot: deploy started: edge-rate-limit v2 by kai-oncall
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded in 3 zones
emma-sre: Edge backpressure in. Observing queue size flattening by ~8% but p99 still bad
infra-eng: Trying node evictions for low-priority background jobs to free GPUs: /scripts/evict_low_priority.sh --pool model-pool-gpu
infra-eng: Eviction completed on 6 nodes, freed 12 GPUs
nora-ml: Can we spin up CPU-quantized variants for latency-sensitive routes? That will reduce GPU pressure
infra-eng: Kicking that: scaling model-variants 'gptx-13b-quant-cpu' to 40 replicas
infra-eng: Autoscaler error persists when trying to create GPUs: "QuotaExceeded: Requested 8 GPUs, available 0". Cloud support case opened: CS-4129
kai-oncall: Temporary fallback: apply routing rule to send 15% of incoming traffic for multi-turn chat to 'gptx-13b-cpu' and 'gptx-7b-quant' to relieve GPU load
emma-sre: Applying routing change
emma-sre: /run routerctl set-weight --route chat-multiturn --variant gptx-13b-cpu=0.1,gptx-7b-quant=0.05
deploy-bot: routing update applied
jordan-support: Seeing reductions in errors for paid customers now. Partner A still seeing some degraded responses; support updated them
maria-product: We should prepare a customer status note if this persists >30m. Any estimate ETA?
kai-oncall: Cloud quota request submitted but approval unknown. Short term ETA 15-45m for internal mitigations to stabilize. I'll update in 10
infra-eng: Observability: p95 dropped from 1200ms -> 650ms after routing + evictions. p99 at 3.2s (was 7.8s). Queue size 250k -> 98k
ops-bot: INCIDENT METRICS: queue_size=98000,p95=650ms,p99=3200ms,error_rate=1.8%
nora-ml: Noting degraded quality risk when routing to smaller models. Set A/B monitoring for quality regressions
emma-sre: Enabling canary checks against eval set
emma-sre: /run eval-check --suite live-critical --target gptx-7b-quant
infra-eng: Also hit a throttling issue in provisioner: we see repeated 429s from cloud API when listing instances. Need to backoff and batch calls
kai-oncall: Implemented exponential backoff in provisioner override, patch pushed
deploy-bot: patch applied to provisioner (id: prov-2026-03-15-01)
infra-eng: After patch and evictions, new node launches succeeded but limited (2 GPUs). Overall stability improving
jordan-support: Customer impact summary in last 45m: intermittent errors for ~120 customers, 6 support tickets from commercial customers, 1 partner escalation. No PII exposed. They experienced 20-40% increased latency and some timeouts
maria-product: Drafting a brief status for customers. Outline: root cause GPU quota + autoscaler errors, mitigations: rate-limit, routing fallback, eviction, provisioner patch, ongoing cloud quota with support
kai-oncall: Handoff to night oncall @ella-sre in 30m. I'll prepare runbook notes
emma-sre: Handing off: issue currently degraded but stable. Key actions pending: cloud quota approval, monitor queue < 50k target, verify p99 < 1.2s. If queue starts climbing again, escalate to infra-leads
kai-oncall: /pin Summary: GPU pool exhausted due to traffic spike + cloud quota. Autoscaler failed with quota/429s. Mitigations: edge rate-limit, route 15% to smaller cpu/quant variants, evict low-priority jobs, provisioner backoff patch. Customer impact limited to latency + timeouts, partner A in touch
ops-bot: REMINDER: open incident channel for postmortem if incident duration > 2 hours
ella-sre: Acknowledged. I'll take the monitor and notify on-call if regression
emma-sre: Thanks team. I'll coordinate post-incident follow-up and root-cause analysis
jordan-support: Notifying affected customers now with current mitigations
maria-product: +1. Keep me posted on cloud case CS-4129
kai-oncall: Last note before handoff: set alert threshold lowered to queue_size > 30k for next 2 hours
deploy-bot: alert rule updated
ella-sre: Taking over at 1719004958. Monitoring
